title: Indira Devi Miss Eugenie Petersen

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
S. B. REGISTRY
No. S. B. D. 7836
3.4, Special Branch. Index 40
Date June 20, 1940.

REPORT

Subject Indira Devi (Miss Eugenie Petersen)

Made by D.S. McKeown. Forwarded by Supt. Mason.

（批：D.C. (Division) Ref. 21/6.）

Regarding the attached report to the effect that
Miss Eugenie Petersen, interpretive dancer made a speech
in the Lahja Gurdwara on 9.6.40, I have to report that
further enquiries show that there is no truth in the
statement that she mentioned co-operation with Russia.
She was invited to the Gurdwara as a friend of the Indian
community and the gist of her speech was that they should
behave themselves outside the Gurdwara as they did inside.
Miss Petersen was interviewed at Headquarters and
confirmed the fact that her speech contained nothing of
a political nature. The first report was obtained by
S.D.C. Mohan Singh who has had little experience on the
C.I.D. and appears to have been misled by an informer.
He has been cautioned against accepting unconfirmed
information in future. On June 19th, Teja Singh and
Kishan Singh, President and Vice President of the
Gurdwara visited this office and presented the attached
letter clarifying the proceedings at the Gurdwara on the
day in question.

（印：DEPUTY COMMISSIONER DIVISIONS 14 JUNE 1940）

FILE

23 6 40

D. S. McKeown
D. S.

D. C. (Special Branch).

报告

事由 英迪拉·德维小姐（尤金妮·彼得森小姐）

由 D.S. McKeown 撰写。由 Mason 警司转呈。

（批注：分区副巡官 (Division) 参考号 21/6。）

关于所附报告称尤金妮·彼得森小姐（现代舞舞者）于1940年6月9日在拉哈贾锡克教庙（Lahja Gurdwara）发表演讲一事，经进一步查讯，现报告如下：所谓她提及与俄国合作的说法并无事实依据。她是作为印度社区的朋友受邀前往该锡克教庙的，其演讲要旨是呼吁他们在庙外应像在庙内一样举止得体。彼得森小姐已在总局接受问询，并证实其演讲内容不含任何政治性质。初份报告由特别科警员 Mohan Singh 获取，该员在刑事侦缉处经验尚浅，似被线人误导。已对其提出告诫，今后不得采信未经证实的情报。6月19日，该锡克教庙主席 Teja Singh 和副主席 Kishan Singh 来访本处，并提交所附信函，澄清当日在该锡克教庙发生之情况。

（印章：分区副巡官 1940年6月14日）

卷宗

1940年6月23日

D. S. McKeown
特别科警员

特别科副巡官。

To
The Deputy Commissioner,
Criminal Investigation Department,
S. M. P.

Shanghai, 19th June 1940

Sir,
Having learned that false reports of Miss Indira Devi's
lecture in our Gurdwara on the 9th instant have reached your Office.
In this respect I beg to clarify the unpleasant atmosphere created
by any reluctant person. There is no doubt she came in the Gurdwara
but her speech was not of a political or of a radical nature in any
way.
Opening her short speech she said, "I am very much pleased to see
the Indians in this international town". You are foreigners here.
You must make your every day life like the rest of the foreign
communities. You should wear neat and clean dresses. You must not
indulge in drinking and spoil your character. You should mend your
ways and means of livelihood .
That is the text of her words and beyond that she spoke no more.
I would rather appreciate and thank her for having given good advice.
A man with a brain in his head would toodo likewise. I very much
regret that a wrong information had been given to you. However the
main aim of the informant is to lower respect of this institution.
Moreover I request you to inquire from me any such matters of which
you suspect before starting further steps. I further beg to assure
you that nothing of a political nature has ever been said or heard
in this religious Institution and there will be no repetition of any
such things in future.
Hoping you will be convinced by this brief and actual statement.

副巡官，
上海公共租界工部局警务处。

上海，1940年6月19日

先生：
获悉有关英迪拉·德维小姐本月9日在本庙演讲的不实报告已呈送贵处。就此，我谨澄清由某些居心不良者造成的不快氛围。毫无疑问，她曾来到本庙，但其演讲绝无政治或激进性质。
她在简短演讲的开篇说道：“很高兴在这座国际都市见到印度同胞”。你们在此地是外国人。你们的日常生活应当与其他外籍社群一样。你们应当衣着整洁干净。不可沉溺饮酒而败坏品行。你们应当端正谋生之道与方式。
此即其言辞全文，此外她未再多言。我反而感激并感谢她提出的良言忠告。稍有理智之人皆会如此行事。对于向贵处提供错误信息，我深表遗憾。然而，举报人的主要目的在于贬低本机构的声誉。此外，我恳请贵处在采取进一步行动之前，先就此类可疑事项向我方查询。我进一步保证，在本宗教机构中从未发表或听闻任何具有政治性质的言论，将来亦不会重演此类事件。
望此简要且真实的陈述能令阁下信服。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
S.4, Special Branch.
REPORT
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE S.B. REGISTER No. S. B. D. 7836 Date June 11, 1940.）

Subject Indira Devi (Miss Eugenie Petersen) makes a speech in Paoshing Road Gurdwara.
Made by. D. S. McKeown. Forwarded by. Supt. Mason.

Indira Devi, interpretive dancer (see attached file) visited the Mahja Gurdwara, No. 318 Chusan Road, at 3 p.m. 9.6.40. During the course of a speech to the assembly, she stated that the Indians in Shanghai should unite and co-operate with Russia, should they desire to gain freedom. She made the speech, partly in English and partly in Hindustani translated by Ranjit Singh, teacher at the Mahja school.

Instructions are respectfully requested regarding the advisability of requesting Miss Petersen to visit Headquarters, as possibly there has been some mistake in the transmission of this report.

D. S.
D. C. (Special Branch).

事由 英迪拉·德维（尤金妮·彼得森小姐）在宝兴路锡克教庙发表演讲。
由 D. S. McKeown 撰写。由 Mason 警司转呈。

英迪拉·德维，现代舞舞者（参见附件卷宗），于1940年6月9日下午3时访问了位于中山路318号的马贾锡克教庙（Mahja Gurdwara）。在向集会人群发表的演讲过程中，她声称上海的印度人若渴望获得自由，便应团结并与俄国合作。她的演讲部分使用英语，部分使用印地语-乌尔都语（Hindustani），由马贾学校的教师 Ranjit Singh 翻译。

鉴于本报告在传递过程中可能存在误传，谨请示是否宜要求彼得森小姐前往总局，敬请指示。

特别科警员
特别科副巡官。

CONFIDENTIAL
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
Section I, Special Branch.
REPORT
File No. 9836
Station, 3 40
Date March 2nd, 19 40.
Subject Eugenie Strskaty, nee Eugenie Petersen, alias Indira Devi.
Made by D.S.I. Ride. Forwarded by D. I. Crawford.

Eugenie Strskaty, nee Eugenie Petersen, alias
Indira Devi, accompanied by her husband, Jan Strskaty,
arrived in Shanghai on December 20th. 1939. They are
at present residing at flat 56, Gascoigne Apartment,
1402, Avenue Joffre.

So far as can be ascertained Mrs. Strskaty
was born in Czechoslovakia in 1899. She married her
present husband at a comparatively early age and in
1929 accompanied him to India where he was manager of
Czechoslovakian Government Export Institute in Bombay
and later in Calcutta.

Whilst in India Mrs. Strskaty suffered
severely from some undetermined disease for which she
received various treatments which proved unavailing.
She then took up the practice of yogi with such
successful results that she became, and still is,
obsessed with this cult to an almost fanatical degree.
She also studied Hindustani which she now speaks fluently
in addition to German and English.

Towards the end of 1938 Mr. Strskaty was
transferred to the staff of the Czechoslovakian Consulate
in Shanghai, but following the occupation of Czechoslo-
vakia by Germany both he and his wife refused to accept
German citizenship in consequence of which he lost his
employment.

On June 15th, 1939, Mrs. Strskaty, in
partnership with a Mr. William Wieder, purchased the
Sipa Macaroni Factory at 394, Chusan Road from Mr. M.

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
第一科，特别科。
报告
档案编号 9836
分局，3 40
日期 1940年3月2日。
事由 Eugenie Strskaty，原名 Eugenie Petersen，化名 Indira Devi。
由 D.S.I. Ride 撰写。由 D. I. Crawford 转呈。

Eugenie Strskaty，原名 Eugenie Petersen，化名 Indira Devi，在其丈夫 Jan Strskaty 陪同下，于1939年12月20日抵达上海。他们目前居住在霞飞路1402号 Gascoigne 公寓56室。

据查，Strskaty 夫人于1899年出生在捷克斯洛伐克。她在较年轻时与现任丈夫结婚，并于1929年随夫前往印度，其夫当时担任捷克斯洛伐克政府出口研究所孟买分部经理，后任加尔各答分部经理。

在印度期间，Strskaty 夫人患有一种不明疾病，病情严重，虽接受各种治疗均无效。随后她开始修习瑜伽，成效显著，以至于她对此流派着迷，甚至达到近乎狂热的程度。她还学习了印地语-乌尔都语，除德语和英语外，现在能流利使用该语言。

1938年底，Strskaty 先生被调至捷克斯洛伐克驻上海领事馆任职，但在德国占领捷克斯洛伐克后，他与其妻均拒绝接受德国国籍，因此他失去了工作。

1939年6月15日，Strskaty 夫人与一位 William Wieder 先生合伙，从 M. 先生手中购买了位于中山路394号的西帕通心粉厂（Sipa Macaroni Factory）。

Snatz. Mr. Strakaty is now actively concerned in
the management of this concern. Mr. Leder, a Pole,
who was formerly general agent for Krupp's Munition
Works, also refused German citizenship after the
German occupation of Poland and in consequence was
forced to resign.
Since her arrival in Shanghai Mrs. Strakaty
has given two exhibitions of Indian dances at the
Lyceum Theatre under the name of Indira Devi. She
also conducts yogi classes at her home and at present
has some twenty or more pupils, most of whom are
American ladies.
So far as can be ascertained, there is no
reason to suspect that Mrs. Strakaty is concerned in
any activities other than those outlined above.

Snatz。Strakaty 先生目前积极参与该企业的经营管理。Leder 先生，波兰人，曾任克虏伯兵工厂总代理，在波兰被德国占领后也拒绝接受德国国籍，因此被迫辞职。
自抵达上海以来，Strakaty 夫人以 Indira Devi 之名在兰心大戏院举办过两次印度舞蹈表演。她还在家中开设瑜伽课程，目前有二十多名学员，其中大多数为美国女士。
据查，没有理由怀疑 Strakaty 夫人参与上述活动以外的任何活动。

SECRET

February 3rd, 1940.

I should be grateful for any information
as to the identity of Mrs. EUGENE STRAKATY,
P.O. Box 1845, Shanghai. She was referred
to in November, 1939, as having given a recital
of Indian dances in Shanghai but the name is
not familiar to me.

"Y"

秘密

1940年2月3日。

如能提供有关 EUGENE STRAKATY 夫人（上海邮政信箱1845号）身份的任何信息，我将不胜感激。1939年11月曾提及她在上海举行印度舞蹈独奏会，但我对该名字并不熟悉。

"Y"
